name: GPU overseer VRAM lease
description: Acquire or release a VRAM lease from the GPU overseer (127.0.0.1:8195) before and after loading a model or running a ComfyUI job, or check that the overseer is up. Acquiring unloads other apps' idle models to make room, so always release afterwards; if the overseer is not running it answers unreachable and the job can proceed without a lease.

client.description: holder name known to the overseer, default comfyui

timeoutSec.description: acquire: how long the overseer may wait for room, default 90

dryRun.description: show the request that would be sent

outputs: acquire: { ok, freeMb, unloaded[] }; release: { ok, released }; status: { ok, overseer }; { ok: false, unreachable: true } when no overseer answers
